My name is Fankai Dai. I am a PhD student in Journalism at The University of Hong Kong.
Previously, I received my B.A. from the College of Media and International Culture at Zhejiang University and my M.A. from the School of Journalism and Communication at Tsinghua University. I also worked as a journalism intern at Caixin Media and The Paper.






In Chinese

Li, H., Liu, Y., Dai, F. (2025). Where’s the Covid-19 testing stations now? Liminal Memoryscape, and Covid-19 Heritage in China’s Urban Space. Communication & Society (TSSCI), 75, 1–36.
Zhou, R., Wang, W., Dai, F., & Zhou, Z. (2021). Learning to make news: How Chinese college students and faculty covered the Covid-19 pandemic. Shanghai Journalism Review (CSSCI), 11, 53–65.
